( cf Sadd 248, 6 foll.: bhavo ca abhavo ca ~aṃ …), 1. [ cf phalāphala sv phala] various kinds of existence; existence after existence; M II 73, 27* (~esu; Ps III 308, 19 : hīnapaṇītesu bhavesu) = Th 784; Sn 496 (yesaṃ tu taṇhā natthi … ~āya idha vā huraṃ vā; cf Pj II 416, 1 foll.: sassatāya vā ucchedāya vā, atha vā bhavassa abhavāya ~āya, punabbhavānabhinibbattiyā ti vuttaṃ hoti); 776 (avītataṇhāse ~esu; Pj II 517, 11 foll.: kāmabhavādisu, atha vā ~esū ti bhavabhavesu, punappunabhavesū ti vuttaṃ hoti); It 44, 15* (vītataṇho ~e; cf It-a I 180, 24 : ~e ti khuddake c’ eva mahante va, ucchedādidassane vā); Ap 69, 25 (~e saṃsaranto); Cp 1:7:6 (demi dānaṃ ~e); Nidd-a II 36, 8 (~o ti bhavato bhavo); — ~âbhisaṅkharaṇa, n. , creating existence after existence; Ud-a 329, 16 (~âbhisaṅkharaṇaṭṭhena, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~âbhisaṅkhāranatthena); — 2. [bhava + abhava], existence and non-existence; prosperity and loss etc; Ud-a 164, 21 (anekappakārā ~-tā); Th-a II 278, 8 (~-vasaṃ gatā ti bhavassa abhavassa ca vasaṃ upagatā); Bv-a 162, 11 foll.; Cp-a 20, 15 foll. Sv 543, 30 foll. (sotāpannassa … aṭṭhame bhave ~aṃ natthi … khīṇāsavassa kismici bhave ~aṃ natthī ti) = Spk III 281, 28 foll.; — °- ttaya , n. , the three states of existence; Spk II 19, 5 (~-saṅkhātaṃ vaṭṭaṃ); Ud-a 430, 18 (~aṃ ādittaṃ viya upaṭṭhāsi); Thī-a 21, 6 (~e taṇhā uppajjati); — °- netti , f. [bhava + netti 1 ; BHS bhavanetrī], what leads to existence; craving; Abh 162 (sibbinī ~i ca); Vin I 231, 5 (ucchinnā °-taṇhā khīṇā ~i natthi dāni punabbhavo ti); M II 105, 14* (~i samūhatā; Ps III 342, 17 : ~ī ti °-rajju, taṇhāya etaṃ nāmaṃ, tāya hi goṇā viya gīvāya rajjuyā sattā hadaye baddhā taṃ taṃ bhavaṃ nīyanti); S III 190, 30 (katamā nu kho bhante ~i katamo ~-nirodho); Th 708 (khīṇāya ~iyā); Nidd I 8, 17 (taṇhā … paṇidhi ~i vanaṃ …); — ~-pabhāvita, mfn. , (what is) produced by craving; Th 767; — see also ucchinnabhavanettika ( sv ucchindati ), chinnabhavanettika ( sv chindati ); — °- paṭilābhiya , °-paṭilābhika, mfn. [ cf BHS -pratilambhika, -pratilābhika], leading to the obtaining of existence; A II 133, 32 (~āni saṃyojanāni, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se °-paṭilābhikāni); — °- (p)pabandha , m. , a continuous sequence of existences; Ud-a 213, 29 ; Thī-a 262, 27 ; — °- saṅkhāra , m. , a motive force, impetus, for existence; D II 107, 3* (~am avassajī muni; Sv 557, 31 : ~an ti bhavagāmikammaṃ) = Ud 64, 29* ; A V 88, 25 (ponobhaviko ~o); — abhava , m. , 1. non-existence; death; Ud-a 164, 16 (~o ti ucchedo); — 2. lack of prosperity; loss, failure; D III 187, 23 (~en’ assa na nandati bhaven’ assa nandati) ≠ Ja IV 197, 24* (~e; 198, 21´ : ~e ti avaḍḍhiyā); — 3. ( in explanation of bhavābhava qv above), a kind of existence; Ps III 223, 22 foll.; Ud-a 164, 17 foll. (bhavo ti vā sugati ~o ti duggati bhavo ti vā khuddako ~o ti mahanto); Nidd-a I 159, 23 foll. (bhavo ti kāmadhātu ~o ti rupārūpadhātu, atha vā bhavo ti kāmadhātu rūpadhātu ~o ti arūpadhātu tesu bhavābhavesu); Paṭis-a 462, 4 (bhavābhave ti khuddake ca mahante ca bhave, vuddhi-atthe pi hi akārassa sambhavato ~o ti mahābhavo); — ifc see bhavābhava above; — see also antimabhavika ( sv antima 1 ), antobhavika ( sv anto ), kāmabhavika ( sv kāma ), pacchimabhavika ( sv pacchima ).
